draft.title: Force field analysis
card: Force field analysis is a model created by Kurt Lewin. It helps a business look at a proposed change by listing the forces on each side.
push towards the change. Examples are falling sales, a new competitor or a new law.
push against the change. Examples are the cost of the change, staff fear of the unknown or habit.

The business weighs the two lists. Change is likely to happen when the driving forces outweigh the restraining forces. A manager can also make change more likely by adding driving forces or by reducing restraining forces.
draft.remember: List the forces for and against a change. Change is likely when the forces for it are stronger.

a.q: What is the main purpose of a force field analysis?
opts: To weigh the forces for and against a proposed change
To rank staff by how much they support a change
To work out the total cost of a proposed change
To list the steps needed to carry out a change
a.why: The model sets driving forces against restraining forces so managers can see how likely a change is to happen. It does not plan the steps or total the cost, although cost may appear as one restraining force.
a.clue: Think about the two lists the model builds.

b.q: Priya manages a bakery in Newcastle. She wants to bring in online ordering. Customers keep asking for it, but two long-serving staff dislike new software. Which is a restraining force?
opts: Two long-serving staff dislike new software
Customers keep asking for online ordering
Rival bakeries already take online orders
Online orders could raise sales over time
b.why: Staff dislike of the software pushes against the change, so it is a restraining force. Customer requests, rival bakeries and higher sales all push towards the change, so they are driving forces. A customer request can feel like pressure, but it pushes the business towards change.
b.clue: Which one pushes against the change rather than for it?

a.best: To weigh the forces for and against a proposed change

b.best: Two long-serving staff dislike new software
